master.title: LAMBO CITY Master Blueprint
master.purpose: The overall vision, shared standards, protected decisions, architecture rules and long-term direction for every department.
rules: Inspect existing code and assets before proposing new work.
Preserve approved features, landmarks, interfaces and working systems.
Prefer modular additions and focused changes over broad rewrites.
Keep departments independently understandable and expandable.
Keep production, billing, security, data deletion and major architecture changes behind owner approval.
Separate verified current capabilities from planned or unverified ideas.
Do not treat generated discovery results as owner-approved requirements.
